payload.description: Norwich uses two versions of its register form and they behave differently. Six of the 17 readable registers are on the February 2016 form, which has a single column headed 'Details of member's interests'; everything on those is shown. The other 11 are on the April 2026 form, which puts a councillor's own answers beside their partner's in the pecuniary table, and the two columns run together when the file is read as text. On those 11, a pecuniary row that lists more than one answer is left out rather than risk printing a partner's job under a councillor's name. The 'other registrable interests' box on both forms is a single list with no partner column, so it is always shown in full. Each councillor's own note says which form theirs is and what, if anything, is missing.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
